x-shillinq-fragment.description: ADR-037 register fragment for the Bookkeeping Compliance + Operations (T2) change. Declares the genuinely-new compliance/operations schemas (FiscalPeriod, CustomerMaster, ARInvoice, DunningRecord, BankStatementLine, MatchingRule, ReconciliationMatch) plus an additive overlay on the existing BankStatement schema (reconciliation fields + lifecycle). AP-core (VendorMaster/APInvoice/PaymentRun), TrialBalance, and BalanceSheet are already shipped in shillinq_register.json by prior changes and are NOT redeclared here per ADR-037.

FiscalPeriod.title: Fiscal Period
FiscalPeriod.description: A monthly/quarterly accounting period. Promotes T1's GLLine.periodId stub-string to a real register with an open -> closing -> closed -> audit-locked lifecycle per REQ-PC-001/REQ-PC-003. Postings against a closed period are rejected. Year-end close is deferred to T3. Per ADR-022 the audit trail and per ADR-031 the lifecycle are consumed/declared, not reimplemented.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this period belongs to.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

state.description: Lifecycle state per REQ-PC-003. audit-locked is terminal.
state.title: State

closedAt.description: Timestamp when state transitioned to closed.
closedAt.title: Closed At

closedBy.description: UUID of the user who closed the period.
closedBy.title: Closed By

auditLockedAt.description: Timestamp when state transitioned to audit-locked.
auditLockedAt.title: Audit Locked At

auditLockedBy.description: UUID of the auditor who locked the period.
auditLockedBy.title: Audit Locked By

reopenedHistory.description: Audit trail of each reopen: {reopenedAt, reopenedBy, reason}.

reopenedAt.title: Reopened At
reopenedAt.description: The date and time for reopened at.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The reason or justification for this state or action.

reopenedHistory.title: Reopened History

open.label: Open
open.description: Postings may be created and posted against this period.

closing.label: Closing
closing.description: Close in progress; trial-balance invariant being verified.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Postings rejected; reopenable by an elevated period-closer role with an audited reason.

audit-locked.label: Audit Locked
audit-locked.description: Terminal. Frozen after auditor sign-off; no further transitions permitted.

start-close.label: Start close
start-close.description: Operator starts the close; trial-balance invariant must verify per REQ-TB-003.

confirm-close.label: Confirm close
confirm-close.description: Operator confirms close; all open AP/AR invoices in the period are settled or explicitly acknowledged. Writes closedAt + closedBy per REQ-PC-003.

reopen.label: Reopen period
reopen.description: Elevated period-closer role only; records the audited reopen reason in reopenedHistory per REQ-PC-003.

audit-lock.label: Audit lock
audit-lock.description: Auditor action. Irreversible; writes auditLockedAt + auditLockedBy per REQ-PC-003.

CustomerMaster.title: Customer Master
CustomerMaster.description: A customer/debtor master record carrying invoice-delivery, dunning-policy, and credit-limit fields per REQ-AR-002. Carries forward the original Shillinq invoicing scope. A contact/person remains a Nextcloud entity per ADR-022; this register is the bookkeeping-side debtor view keyed by customerId.

iban.description: Customer IBAN for SEPA direct debit.
iban.title: IBAN

defaultGlAccount.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for default AR posting.
defaultGlAccount.title: Default GL Account

ublDebtorRef.description: UBL 2.1 AccountingCustomerParty ID, declared for T4 Peppol outbound.
ublDebtorRef.title: Ubl Debtor Ref

invoices.description: Inverse of ARInvoice.customerId; back-reference populated by OpenRegister.
invoices.title: Invoices

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: No longer in use; retained for audit.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Customer Master is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

ARInvoice.title: AR Invoice
ARInvoice.description: A customer (accounts-receivable) invoice sub-ledger record per REQ-AR-003. On issue it materialises a balanced GLTransaction (T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern) and is subject to a credit-limit check. Dunning is consumed from OR's dunning-workflow per REQ-AR-005 (DunningGuard fallback per ADR-031). Payment matching links to a BankStatementLine from bank-reconciliation.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping sub-ledger register; every lifecycle transition (issue / overdue / match / dispute / write-off / void) and every header / line edit is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-RAP-001 / REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

customerId.description: Reference to the CustomerMaster this invoice is billed to (holds its object UUID, NOT the per-administration customer code CustomerMaster.customerId). PortalContributionProvider scopes a debtor's visible invoices on this field against the customerMasterId claim, and its cross-administration isolation argument depends on the value being the globally-unique object UUID.
customerId.title: Customer ID

lifecycleState.description: AR invoice lifecycle state per REQ-AR-004.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

glTransactionId.description: Reference to the GLTransaction materialised on issue (holds its object UUID).
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

matchedBankLineId.description: FK to BankStatementLine.lineId once payment is matched.
matchedBankLineId.title: Matched Bank Line ID

ublRef.description: UBL 2.1 document reference, declared for T4 Peppol BIS 3.0 outbound.
ublRef.title: Ubl Ref

writeOffReason.description: Operator-authored, audit-trailed reason for declaring this invoice uncollectible. Read by WriteOffReasonGuard::requireReason, which blocks both write-off transitions until it is non-empty.
writeOffReason.example: Customer insolvency, court-confirmed uncollectible per ruling 2026-04-22.
writeOffReason.title: Write-Off Reason

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Credit-limit checked; balanced GLTransaction materialised; glTransactionId written.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Payment matched from bank-rec; matchedBankLineId set; payment GLTransaction posted.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.description: Due date passed (OR isOverdue calculation); dunning workflow triggers.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Customer disputes the invoice; dunning paused.

written-off.label: Written off
written-off.description: Bad-debt write-off; compensating GLTransaction posted (debit bad-debt expense, credit AR control).

issue.label: Issue invoice
issue.description: Credit-limit check; materialises a balanced GLTransaction and writes glTransactionId.

write-off-issued.label: Write off
write-off-issued.description: Posts compensating GLTransaction; requires period-closer or ar-controller role. Blocked until writeOffReason is set.

write-off-overdue.label: Write off overdue
write-off-overdue.description: Posts compensating GLTransaction; requires period-closer or ar-controller role. Blocked until writeOffReason is set.

isOverdue.description: Derived overdue flag per REQ-AR-004; drives the automated overdue transition and dunning workflow.

arAging.label: AR Aging
arAging.description: Groups open AR invoices by customer and aging bucket per REQ-AR-008. Excludes paid and written-off invoices.

creditExposure.label: Customer Credit Exposure
creditExposure.description: Sums grossAmount of all non-paid, non-written-off AR invoices per customer for the credit-limit check on issuance per REQ-AR-006.

DunningRecord.title: Dunning Record
DunningRecord.description: A single dunning (aanmaning) communication issued against an overdue AR invoice per REQ-AR-007. DunningRecord objects are written declaratively by OR's dunning-workflow; shillinq carries no app-local dunning service or table per ADR-022.

issuedDate.description: Date the dunning communication was issued.
issuedDate.title: Issued Date

dueDate.description: New payment deadline in the notice.
dueDate.title: Due Date

amount.description: Outstanding amount stated in the notice.
amount.title: Amount

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Dunning Record is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
REQ-AT-001: BankStatement carries an immutable audit trail per ADR-022. Import, lifecycle transitions, and operator actions append audit events.

statementId.description: Unique statement identifier (e.g. BS-2026-001) per REQ-BR-002. Additive overlay field for the reconciliation flow.
statementId.title: Statement ID

bankAccountIban.description: IBAN of the reconciled bank account per REQ-BR-002.
bankAccountIban.title: Bank Account IBAN

periodStart.description: First date covered by the statement per REQ-BR-002.
periodStart.title: Period Start

periodEnd.description: Last date covered by the statement per REQ-BR-002.
periodEnd.title: Period End

openingBalance.description: Opening balance per the bank (EUR) per REQ-BR-002.
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

closingBalance.description: Closing balance per the bank (EUR) per REQ-BR-002.
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

importedAt.description: Timestamp the operator uploaded the file per REQ-BR-002.
importedAt.title: Imported At

importedBy.description: UUID of the user who uploaded the statement per REQ-BR-002.
importedBy.title: Imported By

fileChecksum.description: SHA-256 hash of the imported file for duplicate-import rejection per REQ-BR-009.
fileChecksum.title: File Checksum

transactionCount.description: Number of BankStatementLine rows parsed from this statement.
transactionCount.title: Transaction Count

lifecycleState.description: Bank-statement reconciliation lifecycle state per REQ-BR-008.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

sourceDocumentUri.description: Docudesk FK URI for the original bank-statement file per REQ-BR-002 (consume bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration).
sourceDocumentUri.title: Source Document URI

duplicateChecksum.description: REQ-BR-009: re-uploading the identical statement file (same SHA-256) within the same administration is rejected as a duplicate import.

overlappingPeriod.description: REQ-BR-009: a second statement covering an overlapping [periodStart, periodEnd] window for the same bank account is rejected as a duplicate import.

imported.label: Imported
imported.description: Statement imported; lines parsed; not yet reconciled.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.description: Operator is reconciling lines against AR/AP.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: All lines matched or routed to suspense; no unmatched lines remain.

complete-reconciliation.label: Confirm reconciliation
complete-reconciliation.description: All lines MUST be matched or routed-to-suspense; no unmatched lines remain per REQ-BR-008.

reopen.label: Reopen reconciliation
reopen.description: Elevated role required; records reopen in audit trail.

BankStatementLine.title: Bank Statement Line
BankStatementLine.description: A single transaction line within a BankStatement per REQ-BR-003. Parsed from CAMT.053, MT940, or manual CSV import. Matched against AR/AP via MatchingRule predicates (REQ-BR-004/REQ-BR-005/REQ-BR-006); unmatched lines route to a suspense account.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: REQ-AT-001: BankStatementLine carries an immutable audit trail per ADR-022. Match-state transitions, suspense routings, and operator confirmations append audit events.

lineId.description: Unique line identifier within the statement.
lineId.title: Line ID

lineNumber.description: Ordinal position of the line within the statement (1-based), preserved from the source file.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

transactionDate.description: Transaction date if different from value date.
transactionDate.title: Transaction Date

amount.description: Transaction amount (positive = credit, negative = debit, EUR).
amount.title: Amount

narrative.description: Free-form bank-side description (e.g. CAMT.053 AddtlNtryInf or MT940 :86: subfield). Distinct from remittanceInfo: narrative is the bank's text, remittanceInfo is the operator/counterparty reference.
narrative.title: Narrative

rawPayload.description: Raw source-line text (CAMT.053 <Ntry> fragment, MT940 :61:+:86: pair, or CSV row) preserved for auditor traceability. May be null on legacy imports.
rawPayload.title: Raw Payload

unmatched.label: Unmatched
unmatched.description: Awaiting candidate match emission or operator action.

matched.label: Matched
matched.description: A confirmed ReconciliationMatch covers this line.

routed-to-suspense.label: Routed to suspense
routed-to-suspense.description: Operator marked the line unmatched-final; a balanced GLTransaction materialised against the designated Account.isSuspenseAccount per REQ-BR-007.

mark-matched.label: Mark matched
mark-matched.description: Set when a ReconciliationMatch covering this line transitions to status=confirmed.

route-to-suspense.label: Route to suspense
route-to-suspense.description: Operator action per REQ-BR-007: materialises a balanced GLTransaction debiting (or crediting) the designated suspense Account against the bank-account GL. Declarative per the T1 REQ-JE-007 materialisation pattern; no PHP suspense-routing service.

MatchingRule.title: Matching Rule
MatchingRule.description: A predicate-based rule that matches bank statement lines against AR/AP invoices or journals per REQ-BR-004/REQ-BR-005. Rule predicates are declared as schema metadata (ADR-031); an x-openregister-aggregations query consumes them to emit ReconciliationMatch candidates. No PHP rule-engine.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: REQ-AT-001: MatchingRule carries an immutable audit trail per ADR-022. Rule authoring, predicate edits, priority changes, and active/disabled flips append audit events.

priority.description: Lower number = higher priority (evaluated in order) per REQ-BR-004.
priority.title: Priority

targetType.description: Which register the rule matches against per REQ-BR-004.
targetType.title: Target Type

autoConfirm.description: If true, candidate matches are auto-confirmed; else operator-confirmed per REQ-BR-004/REQ-BR-006. Default false: bookkeeper trust is built first; auto-confirm is a future enhancement once rule packs are mature.
autoConfirm.title: Auto Confirm

confidenceScore.description: Per-rule confidence score in [0,1] surfaced on emitted ReconciliationMatch candidates per REQ-BR-005. Used by the UI to rank suggestions.
confidenceScore.title: Confidence Score

predicates.description: Ordered array of predicate objects per REQ-BR-005. Predicates in the same rule MUST be combined with logical AND; cross-rule combinations are handled by priority ordering.

op.description: Predicate operator per REQ-BR-005. T2 baseline: exact-amount, amount-range, reference-match, counterparty-fuzzy, date-window. Legacy ops (exact/contains/regex) retained for backwards compatibility with rules authored before REQ-BR-005 was finalised.
op.title: Op

field.description: Which BankStatementLine field to match on (e.g. remittanceInfo, amount, counterpartyIban, counterpartyName). Optional when op carries an implicit field (e.g. exact-amount → amount).
field.title: Field

amount.description: Predicate amount for exact-amount per REQ-BR-005.
amount.title: Amount

min.description: Lower bound for amount-range per REQ-BR-005.
min.title: Min

max.description: Upper bound for amount-range per REQ-BR-005.
max.title: Max

pattern.description: Regex pattern for reference-match per REQ-BR-005.
pattern.title: Pattern

name.description: Counterparty name for counterparty-fuzzy per REQ-BR-005.
name.title: Name

threshold.description: Levenshtein similarity threshold for counterparty-fuzzy in [0,1] per REQ-BR-005.
threshold.title: Threshold

days.description: Day window for date-window: line date MUST be within ±days of the target object's invoiceDate or dueDate per REQ-BR-005.
days.title: Days

value.description: Legacy match target or pattern for op=exact/contains/regex. Declared as a string: OpenRegister rejects a property with no `type` outright ("Property at '/predicates/items/properties/value' must have a 'type' field"), which failed the whole MatchingRule schema and — because ImportHandler's PASS 1 empties schemasMap around each importSchema() call and only restores it on the success path — silently dropped every schema imported BEFORE it from the register, 74 of them. Numeric legacy values are carried as their string form; the typed successors (amount/min/max/days/threshold) are the non-legacy path.
value.title: Value

matchTarget.description: Legacy per-predicate match target; superseded by the top-level targetType field.
matchTarget.title: Match Target

predicates.title: Predicates

ReconciliationMatch.title: Reconciliation Match
ReconciliationMatch.description: A candidate or confirmed match between a bank statement line and an AR/AP invoice, journal, or suspense routing per REQ-BR-006. Emitted by the matching aggregation (confidence=auto) or operator-created (confidence=manual); the operator confirms or rejects. Confirmed matches emit a `reconciliation-match-confirmed` event consumed by AR/AP invoice lifecycles per REQ-BR-006.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: REQ-AT-001: ReconciliationMatch carries an immutable audit trail per ADR-022. Candidate emission, operator confirm/reject, and downstream invoice transitions append audit events.

bankStatementLineId.description: FK to BankStatementLine.lineId for the single-line case. For multi-line matches use bankLineRefs.
bankStatementLineId.title: Bank Statement Line ID

bankLineRefs.description: N×M multi-line support per REQ-BR-006: one bank line covering multiple invoices, or multiple bank lines covering one invoice. When set, the array supersedes bankStatementLineId.
bankLineRefs.title: Bank Line Refs

targetRefs.description: N×M multi-line support per REQ-BR-006: array of matched AR/AP/GL object UUIDs. When set, the array supersedes matchedObjectId.
targetRefs.title: Target Refs

matchType.description: What the line matched against (alias: candidateType in legacy tasks docs).
matchType.title: Match Type

matchedObjectId.description: UUID of the matched AR/AP invoice, GLTransaction, or journal (alias: candidateId in legacy tasks docs). For multi-target matches use targetRefs.
matchedObjectId.title: Matched Object ID

matchedAmount.description: Amount matched (EUR). For partial matches this is less than the target invoice total.
matchedAmount.title: Matched Amount

partial.description: REQ-BR-006: when true the match covers part of the target invoice total; AR transitions to partially-paid, AP appends a partial-payment audit event.
partial.title: Partial

confidenceScore.description: Confidence score in [0,1] copied from the emitting MatchingRule per REQ-BR-005.
confidenceScore.title: Confidence Score

status.description: Operator confirmation status (alias: state in legacy tasks docs). REQ-BR-006 lifecycle: candidate → confirmed / candidate → rejected.
status.title: Status

rejectedReason.description: Operator-supplied reason when status=rejected (e.g. 'not the right invoice', 'amount mismatch').
rejectedReason.title: Rejected Reason

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Candidate emitted by the matching aggregation; awaiting operator confirmation.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Operator confirmed (or autoConfirm=true rule); emits reconciliation-match-confirmed event consumed by AR/AP invoice lifecycles.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Operator rejected the candidate; line returns to unmatched for further matching attempts.

confirm.label: Confirm match
confirm.description: Emit reconciliation-match-confirmed event per REQ-BR-006; AR/AP invoice lifecycles consume it.

reject.label: Reject candidate
reject.description: Rejects the candidate; bank line remains unmatched per REQ-BR-006.

matchCandidates.label: Reconciliation Match Candidates
matchCandidates.description: Consumes active MatchingRule predicates and emits ReconciliationMatch candidates for unmatched BankStatementLine rows per REQ-BR-006. Per REQ-BR-004, the first matching rule by priority (lowest number first) emits the candidate; lower-priority rules MUST NOT produce a duplicate candidate for the same line. Predicates within a rule combine with logical AND. No PHP rule-engine.

emits.description: When autoConfirm is true the emitted ReconciliationMatch is created with status=confirmed directly, triggering the reconciliation-match-confirmed event consumed by AR/AP invoice lifecycles per REQ-BR-006.
